decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The Authority refused to grant approval for the following reason:
The proposed siting and appearance of the development is considered to represent an inappropriate and obtrusive feature in the locality, the effect of which would unduly impact on the visual amenity of the area, particularly having regard to concerns which have been expressed about the potential detriment to health by emissions from telecommunications apparatus of the kind proposed. the proposal is therefore contrary to policies ENV. 1.1 and ENV 1.12 of the adopted Unitary Development Plan; ploicies ENV B 1.1 and ENV B.1.7 of the Review Deposit Unitary Development Plan and Planning Policy Guidance Note 8: Telecommunications.
description: Erection of 3 antennae and 3 microwave dishes 1X0.3mX2X0.6m on existing air traffic control tower with associated ground based meter cabinets.
